description: Accounting shared by every study of the article (Section 3.1 and Appendix A). One step is one observation interval, a minute in the bearing replay. rebuild_tables.py implements it in consequences().
after_failure: Production stops, completed preparation is kept, and the preparation still missing runs without production before the exchange and the downtime.

formulas.last_safe_order: T - L, where T is the last productive step and L the preparation steps
formulas.timely_order: first order o with o <= T - L: productive steps U = o + L, nonproductive steps N = 7, failure F = 0
formulas.late_or_missing_order: U = T and F = 1; N = 7 + L - (T - o) after a late order and N = 7 + L without an order
formulas.unused_fraction: (T - U) / (T - L), zero for a failed life

maintenance_arena_settings.note: The core task of the package fixes mobilization_lead 12, one exchange step, six downtime steps and these prices; its default recovery is immediate_exchange_v1, so the article's setting needs the override above (examples/preserved_preparation.yaml).
